title: Geographic gap fill — traditions added from the audit's verified gap list
method: Each row was authored from a candidate that survived the audit's absence check and skeptic, then checked by an independent reviewer for facts, duplicates, instruments, map pin and rendered wording. Instruments are existing catalog cards; where the documented instrument has no card, the lineage names the stand-in. Recording chains and numeric axes are authored modeling choices, not measured session data; parts default to explicit source-unspecified variants.
